description: GPL WM-Open is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. Data catalogue to provide information about gas pipeline infrastructure in the West Midlands Local Distribution Zone (LDZ), spanning from 1850 to the present day. It documents the evolution of pipeline networks, with each entry representing an aggregated length of the pipe, detailing it's geographic LDZ, material composition, and the pressure tier. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Asset, Open. Its keywords are Gas Pipeline, Pipeline Length. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence 3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
